text:
sam: Heads-up — found an edge case in per-org rate policy: exemptions + grace window interaction can effectively skip concurrency checks for some orgs. anyone seen this?
maria: ugh. do you have a repro or logs?
sam: minimal repro attached. quick summary: when an org has "exempt": true AND grace_window_ms > 0 the router preflight short-circuits and never attaches a concurrency token, so requests pile up.
sam: example config snippet I used:
```json
{
  "org_id": "org_123",
  "exempt": true,
  "grace_window_ms": 30000,
  "concurrency_cap": 20
}
```
cheng: is the short-circuit happening in preflight auth or in the rate limiter?
sam: preflight auth -> it returns ALLOWED and we skip quota reservation. the concurrency layer expects a reservation token. result: no decrement/inflight tracking.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-9832 :rotating_light: (link: https://incidents.internal/INC-9832)
raul: we discussed exemptions for enterprise a while back — they were meant to avoid billing throttles for partners, not to bypass safety. we need to be explicit in policy.
tess: for rollout: add a feature flag like "exempt_bypass_concurrency" default=false. console should surface a warning when enabled on an org.
product-ux: can we surface the expected impact in the console? e.g., last 24h peak QPS, potential concurrency overflow risk. also wording: "By enabling this, you allow requests to bypass concurrency safeguards. Use only with ops approval."
maria: telemetry requirements: we need metrics scoped by org and flag state: "exempted_requests_total", "exempted_concurrency_overflow_count", and "grace_window_hits". also tag events with feature-flag version.
dennis: audit logs: record who toggled exempt + timestamp + reason. must be immutable and stored in org audit stream.
sam: proposal: change behavior so "exempt" only bypasses token accounting for billing (quota usage) but STILL enforces concurrency caps and inflight accounting. that keeps safety while preserving billing exceptions.
cheng: agree. implementation notes: 1) move short-circuit out of preflight auth, 2) always allocate an inflight token before honoring exempt, 3) add an adapter layer that skips token consumption but not token allocation when flag set. add unit + integration tests.
raul: also think about fallback policies: if concurrency queue > threshold, fallback to lower-cost model or regional fallback. document in runbook.
tess: console UX: add a modal that requires entering the business justification when toggling. store justification in audit.
product-ux: i'll draft wording and a mock for the modal by EOD.
sam: i'll open a PR with the change + tests and a canary rollout plan (flag gating). aiming for canary within 48h.
maria: please include telemetry dashboards (per-org) and an alert if exempted_concurrency_overflow_count > 0 for any org.
sam: noted. PR will include dashboard json and alert rules.
cheng: ping me on the PR for review. I'll run the integration test harness.
ops-bot: deploy plan checklist: add canary cohort, monitor metrics, enforce automatic rollback on error budget breach.
sam: thanks — will update the incident and link PR.
raul: tagging security review as well since this impacts safety guarantees.
product-ux: thanks all.
